capabilities: Runs the next available command bound to a shared hotkey
Skips commands Obsidian reports as unavailable
Keeps Obsidian's native hotkey ordering in charge
Restores native dispatch when the plugin is unloaded
Ships a demo vault with a note per feature
disambiguation: Not a fallback keybinding; it runs another command that is already bound to the same shortcut.
extras: Desktop only. Not in the official Community Plugins repository yet; beta releases are installed through BRAT. Setup, ordering and limitations are documented in a demo vault shipped with each release rather than in the README.
problem: When two commands share a shortcut, an unavailable first command can swallow the keypress so nothing runs.
summary: Plugin that runs the next command bound to the same hotkey when the first matching command is unavailable.
